why.initial: The first column is never skipped.
why.terminal: A finishing column is never skipped.
why.virtual: It is not a column of the board.
why.no_skip: The board marks this column as never skipped.
why.refinement: This column decides the skips, so it always runs.
why.approvals: It asks a person for an approval, so it always runs.
why.pull_request: It handles the pull request or the release, so it always runs.
